name: ARM Memory Model
description: The ARMv7/v8 model is similar to POWER in permitting non-MCA behaviour and extensive reorderings. ARMv8 was later strengthened to be multi-copy atomic. Barriers: DMB, DSB, ISB.

mca.note: Pre-v8 ARM is non-multicopy-atomic; Pulte et al. adopt multicopy atomicity for ARMv8, explicitly departing from the earlier non-MCA ARM model.

catSupport.note: herd7's arm.cat / aarch32.cat, the ARMv7 model in the same Herding cats lineage.
